verdict.rationale: vLLM's own documentation lists "Disaggregated prefill, decode, and encode" as a feature, so the product itself directly claims the capability. The evidence is a single feature-list line with no configuration, architecture or performance detail, so how deep or production-ready the support is remains unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on setting up disaggregated prefill/decode (KV transfer, deployment topology), evidence of large-scale serving benefits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
